source.title: 16 Spots to Try Street Food in Hanoi in 2026

hooks: Went back to Vua Banh Mi Chao three times (source article)
Phở Gia Truyền Bát Đàn was her first bowl of pho in Vietnam (source article)
Suggests ordering a small egg coffee at The Note Coffee because it is so rich (source article)

list.title: Street food in Hanoi: Madison's 13 spots
list.desc: Places from Madison's Footsteps's '16 Spots to Try Street Food in Hanoi in 2026' (https://madisonsfootsteps.com/street-food-in-hanoi/). Collected by PinWith, not made by Madison's Footsteps.

items.title: Bánh Mì 25
items.memo: Order it with avocado; a huge sandwich plus water was about 55,000 VND.

items.title: Bamichao (Vua Bánh Mì Chảo)
items.memo: Bánh mì chảo thập cẩm: pan bread with mixed meats, cheese and eggs.
items.check: article gives 16 Thanh Hà; matched listing shows 1 Thanh Hà

items.title: Bún Chả Ta
items.memo: Bún chả with spring rolls; with a Saigon beer about 150,000 VND.

items.title: Bún Chả Đắc Kim
items.memo: Bún chả at communal tables on tiny plastic stools.

items.title: Bún Bò Nam Bộ Bách Phương
items.memo: Stir-fried beef noodle salad, best with a cold Bia Sài Gòn.

items.title: Mr Bảy Miền Tây
items.memo: Crispy bánh xèo you cut, roll in rice paper and dip.

items.title: Phở Sướng
items.memo: Pho with fried tofu cakes; rumored Bourdain favorite.

items.title: Phở 10 Lý Quốc Sư
items.memo: Pho under a big mound of coriander; recommended by hostel staff.

items.title: Phở Gia Truyền Bát Đàn
items.memo: Madison's first pho in Vietnam; add the spicy peppers.

items.title: King Roti Hàng Gai
items.memo: Messy chocolate roti; ask for extra napkins.

items.title: The Note Coffee
items.memo: Egg coffee among walls of sticky notes; a small is plenty.

items.title: Cà Phê Giảng
items.memo: Egg coffee since 1946, made with yolks when milk was scarce.

items.title: Cà Phê Đinh
items.memo: Second-floor egg coffee up a dim hallway near Hoan Kiem Lake.

message.subject: I listed your Hanoi street food guide on one map
message.body:
Hi Madison, I'm Adrian from PinWith, a map-list app.

Going back to Bamichao three times says more than any review could, and I loved the extra-napkins warning for King Roti. I put 13 of the places into one map: https://pinwith.me/@pinwith_en/madisonsfootsteps-hanoi-street-food

It's private for now: only this link opens it, and I'll delete it if you'd rather I didn't.

With PinWith, your readers can follow in your footsteps: revisit the places you went or plan their own trip from one map, in their own language. That helps your content reach further.

If you like it, I'll move it to your account, credited to you, so you can link it in the post. Lists like this can also earn curators extra income: https://pinwith.me/for-creators?lang=en
No reply needed if it's not useful.

Adrian
